AMARILLO OUSEHOLD AZARDOUS ASTE ROGRAM
Drop-off events are held the second Friday and Saturday of every month.
For an appointment, please call:
(805) 987-0717
ACCEPTED ITEMS: antifreeze, solvents, pesticides, household cleaners,
pool and garden chemicals, household and car batteries, lancets
(in approved containers), electronics, fluorescent light tubes, cathode ray tubes
(CRTs), compressed gas cylinders, fire extinguishers, oil based paint, latex paint,
mercury-containing devices, medication (no controlled substances), antifreeze,
gasoline, propane tanks, frying oil, and motor oil and filters.
DO NOT BRING: Explosives, ammunition, fireworks, tires, radio-active waste,
infectious waste, MAPP gas cylinders, compressed gas cylinders, or garbage.
